note: A single pull-in grass site in partial shade for up to ten people on First Fork Road (shown as Dry Run on Google Maps). The agency's route from Renovo follows PA 144 south 8.9 miles, turns sharp right onto Barneys Ridge Road and keeps right after 1.5 miles onto First Fork Road; the page puts the site about a mile along, but its coordinates are about 1.7 miles farther north than those of site SS019, which carries the same directions. The agency cautions that it is reached by remote dirt or gravel forest roads that may not suit low-clearance vehicles or large RVs. No table, toilet or water. Pack out trash. --Claude
summary: Site page re-read: SS020 still listed, Drive-In, Tent/Trailer categories, max vehicle 40 ft (equipment length 25), pull-in grass driveway 75 ft; count 1 and 40 ft confirmed, pull_through false and a sites note added. Year-round confirmed; sells in all five windows (Reserved 2026-11-27 to 11-30). Fees confirmed, $6.50 reservation fee added; hookups and facilities none. Imagery (Esri and PASDA): pin in an open brushy grass opening about 35 m north of the forest road; pad not distinct, pin not moved. NHD: Dry Run 122 m; not waterfront.
flags: Directions: the page repeats SS019's text ('keep right onto First Fork Road (Dry Run). Site is approximately 1 mile'), but the booking and GIS coordinates (41.28948,-77.80547) lie 2.7 km north of SS019 (41.26542,-77.80421). The note says so; the pin follows the coordinates. The page's 'Facility Longitude' is a typo (-778054678); its 'GIS Details' longitude is right.

Agency access statements (ruling 11: nothing measured, no road surface, gate or bridge research): 'Caution: This campsite is accessed by remote state forest dirt or gravel roads and may not be suitable for some low-clearance vehicles or large RVs.' No grade lines, no Severe grade, no 4WD, wet-weather or low-clearance statement (clearance 40 ft). Kept. Boilerplate on every page of the district, not site-specific: 'State forest roads are not maintained in the winter and often become snow covered, icy and potentially impassable' and '4WD vehicles may be recommended for some sites year-round, check notes' (this site's notes say nothing about 4WD).
Waterfront: NHD puts Dry Run 122 m from the pin; nothing nearer. Stays not waterfront.
ATV check (ruling 1): nothing on the site page, GIS record or district map places this site in an ATV parking lot. Kept.

Sproul advisories page (read 2026-11-10): nothing on this site's road. It carries a Bloody Skillet ATV section closure (April 20, 2026), the indefinite Left Branch Young Womans Creek Road closure, 'Stay Alert for ATVs on Roads' and a dust advisory.

NAME: the '(Snow Shoe)' in the stored name is only the booking system's loop label. The site is on First Fork Road off Barneys Ridge Road, south of Renovo. Suggest a name that says where it is; apply.py does not write names.

Agency pages disagree on the district's own inventory: the Sproul camping page says 'Sproul State Forest offers nine roadside campsites for overnight camping in RVs. No tent camping permitted. Self-contained toilets are required.' while the booking system sells many more Sproul sites than nine. Nothing here depends on it.
